name: coin-collecting-app
description: Coin Odyssey — coin collection manager for numismatists. Expo/React Native mobile app with a Supabase backend.
_comment_workspaces: web-app is a workspace again from web 1.0. It must pin exactly the same react and react-dom as mobile-app: two React versions in one install get hoisted to the root and black-screen the mobile app (2026-08-09). Check `npm ls react` after any dependency change.
author: Jason Alvarez
